headlines.title: 央行上海总部：扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策 积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行上海总部8月4日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，人民银行上海总部要扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策，积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求。用好各项结构性货币政策工具。贯彻落实金融“五篇大文章”1+N系列政策。推动债券市场“科技板”在上海持续见效。稳步深化金融改革和对外开放，构建完善外汇管理体制机制。落实跨境贸易投融资高水平开放、境外放款、境外上市等各项新政。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Solidly implement moderately accommodative monetary policy, actively push financial institutions to tap effective credit demand
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China Shanghai Head Office held its H2 2026 work conference on August 4. The meeting stressed that the Shanghai Head Office should solidly implement a moderately loose monetary policy, actively encourage financial institutions to explore effective credit demand, and make good use of various structural monetary policy tools. It should implement the 1+N series policies for the 'five major areas' of finance, promote the sustained effectiveness of the 'Technology Board' for the bond market in Shanghai, steadily deepen financial reform and opening-up, improve the foreign exchange management system and mechanisms, and implement new policies for high-level opening-up of cross-border trade, investment and financing, overseas lending, and overseas listings.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: Chart | Ranking global price-to-income ratios, which countries make homebuying easiest?
headlines.summary_en: Based on UN-Habitat's 'World Cities Report 2026', the chart below compares the ratio of median home prices to median annual household income across over 180 countries. A lower ratio indicates stronger affordability. Saudi Arabia and the UAE have the lowest price-to-income ratios, both at 3.0. The US ranks seventh from the bottom with a ratio of 4.5, below Canada (9.4), Australia (7.5), and the UK (8.3). In recent years, rising US mortgage rates and constrained housing supply have weakened affordability. Even so, globally, US home prices remain relatively low relative to household income. On the other hand, Syria tops the world with a price-to-income ratio of 86.7, followed by Sri Lanka (40.8) and China (34.6). headlines.title: 中国财政部多个期限点心债发行利率创新低 认购倍数逾一年新高
headlines.summary: 中国财政部周三公告，在香港发行了规模150亿元人民币主权债，其中2年期、15年期和30年期品种发行利率均创新低。3年期和5年期发行利率刷新2011年以来最低水平。5只人民币主权债的整体认购倍数4.67倍，为2025年6月来最高。发行2年期50亿元，发行利率1.27%；3年期40亿元，发行利率1.30%；5年期40亿元，发行利率1.43%；15年期10亿元，发行利率1.99%；30年期10亿元，发行利率2.24%。

headlines.title_en: China's Ministry of Finance sees record-low yields on multiple tenors of dim sum bonds, subscription multiples hit over one-year high
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday that it issued RMB 15 billion in sovereign bonds in Hong Kong, with offering rates for the 2-year, 15-year, and 30-year tranches all hitting record lows. Rates for the 3-year and 5-year tranches hit the lowest since 2011. The overall subscription ratio for the five RMB sovereign bond tranches was 4.67 times, the highest since June 2025. The 2-year tranche saw RMB 5 billion issued at a rate of 1.27%; the 3-year tranche RMB 4 billion at 1.30%; the 5-year tranche RMB 4 billion at 1.43%; the 15-year tranche RMB 1 billion at 1.99%; and the 30-year tranche RMB 1 billion at 2.24%.

headlines.title_en: Aug 5 midday close: STAR 50 Index up over 5% in half-day trading, semiconductor chip stocks rally broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets opened lower but rose through the morning, with the STAR 50 Index up over 5%. Semiconductor chip stocks strengthened broadly, with Zhongjuxin, Zhengfan Technology, Jinhaitong, Dawei Co., and others hitting limit-up. The precious metals sector rallied, with Sichuan Gold hitting limit-up. PCB concept stocks rose, with Zhongjing Electronics, Huazheng New Materials and others hitting limit-up. Intelligent driving concepts were active, with Suoling Co., Zhejiang Shibao, Xingmin Zhitong and others hitting limit-up. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,900 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets in the green, and morning turnover of RMB 1.7 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.34%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.56%, and the ChiNext rose 0.89%. 2. By sector concept, semiconductor chips, precious metals, computing hardware, and consumer electronics led gains; oil & gas, banks, baijiu, and traditional Chinese medicine fell against the trend. 3. Across the two markets, 3,631 stocks rose, with 89 hitting limit-up; 1,351 fell, with 2 hitting limit-down.

headlines.title_en: Morning News Roundup
headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index rose over 5% in the morning session, with semiconductor chip stocks strengthening broadly. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.11% in the morning; Hang Seng Tech Index and Hang Seng Biotech Index rose over 1%; MINIMAX jumped over 11%. Asia-Pacific stocks advanced on rising expectations of a US-Iran deal, with Seoul's KOSPI up over 4% and Japan's Nikkei 225 up over 3%; oil fell over 1%. US media: a temporary agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is 'close.' Trump said talks with Iran are progressing well, with more news expected in the next 48 hours. Kansas City Fed President Schmid said policy needs to be tightened to lower inflation. A-share 'Yizhongtian' companies jointly responded to the US optical module ban. Reports: DeepSeek restarts fundraising at a pre-investment valuation of RMB 500 billion. Wholly foreign-owned public funds entering investment advisory? Channel sources say preparations are underway.

headlines.title: A股“易中天”集体回应美国光模块禁令
headlines.summary: A股通信设备板块今日开盘下跌，随后跌幅集体收窄。有市场消息称，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在起草一项禁令，旨在禁止美国进口中国数据中心组件新机型，包括光模块。当日，记者以投资者身份分别致电中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信董秘办。中际旭创董秘办工作人员称，公司已注意到相关市场信息，经核实，美国联邦通信委员会尚未出台相关领域限制性文件。该负责人称，“因为美国联邦通信委员会并未出台相关领域限制性文件，公司对相关传闻不予评述。”

headlines.title_en: A-share 'Yizhongtian' companies collectively respond to US optical module ban
headlines.summary_en: A-share communications equipment sector opened lower today, then narrowed losses. Market sources said the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is drafting a ban aimed at prohibiting US imports of new models of Chinese data center components, including optical modules. On the day, reporters called the board secretary offices of Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink, and TFC Optical Communication as investors. Zhongji Innolight's board secretary office staff said the company had noted the market information, and after verification, the FCC has not yet issued restrictive documents in the relevant field. The representative said, 'Because the FCC has not issued restrictive documents in the relevant field, the company will not comment on related rumors.'
